title: 1-Hour Amsterdam Canal Cruise from Central Station
description: The classic first taste of Amsterdam from the water — a relaxed 1-hour cruise departing near Central Station, gliding past the Golden Bend, the Skinny Bridge, and the Anne Frank House with multilingual audio commentary.
imageAlt: A canal cruise boat gliding past historic Amsterdam houses and trees
bestFor: First-time visitors who want the classic canal view

title: Evening Canal Cruise with Dutch Wine & Cheese
description: The same iconic route after dark, with a tasting of Dutch cheeses, wine, and jenever on board in a covered, heated saloon boat — every gabled townhouse and houseboat glowing as you glide past.
imageAlt: Amsterdam canal houses glowing at dusk with lights reflecting on the water

title: Canal Cruise with Dutch Pancake Tasting
description: Combine the sightseeing cruise with a warm stroopwafel or Dutch pancake tasting on board — a cozy, slower-paced way to enjoy the canals while sampling local classics as the houseboats drift by.
imageAlt: A row of historic Dutch canal houses lining an Amsterdam canal
bestFor: Travelers who want sightseeing plus a real Dutch treat

title: Van Gogh Museum Skip-the-Line + Canal Cruise Combo
description: See Amsterdam twice — first inside the Van Gogh Museum's skip-the-line entrance, then from the water on a 1-hour canal cruise. Two of the city's best experiences, booked as one ticket.
imageAlt: Colorful gabled buildings lining a canal in Amsterdam
bestFor: First-timers who want art and canals in one day
